profile.ja: 南米十三家族のひとつ、ラブレス家に仕えるハウスメイド。本名はロザリタ・チスネロス。キューバで訓練を受けたFARC（コロンビア革命軍）の脱走した元女兵士。中米ゲリラ会議で最も注目されたテロリストとして「フローレンシアの猟犬」の異名を持つ。戦闘能力で右に出るものはいないが、料理のセンスは壊滅的らしい。
profile.en: They are a housemaid serving the Lovelace family, one of the thirteen families of South America. Their real name is Rosalita Chisneros, a former female soldier who received training in Cuba and deserted from FARC, the Colombian revolutionary army. They are known as "The Hound of Florencia," the most notorious terrorist at the Central American Guerrilla Conference. While they have unparalleled combat abilities, their sense of cooking is reportedly disastrous.

text.ja: ……私はロベルタ。南米十三家族のひとつ、ラブレス家にてメイド長を務めております。対魔忍の皆様、どうぞお見知りおきを
text.en: ……I'm Roberta. I serve as the head maid of the Lovelace family, one of the thirteen families of South America. It's a pleasure to meet you, Taimanin.

text.ja: ここが五車の町でございますか。何やら破廉恥な恰好の女性がそこら中を歩いていて……ガルシア様にはとてもお見せできません
text.en: Is this the town of Gosha? There are women walking around in rather indecent attire everywhere... I couldn't possibly show you to Master Garcia.

text.ja: この国は平和で穏やかですね。このような場所で生まれたのなら、私も……いえ、これは意味のない繰り言でございます
text.en: This country is so peaceful and calm. If I had been born in a place like this, I might have... but that's just an empty sentiment.

text.ja: ところでご主人様、アキハバラ……という街を案内していただけませんか？　ガルシア様へのお土産のアニメグッズを買い揃えたく
text.en: By the way, Master, would you be so kind as to show me around Akihabara? I'd like to buy some anime merchandise as a gift for Master Garcia.

text.ja: ふうま屋敷で御奉公をしていると、時折あのメイドに強く当たられて困惑いたします。これは……“わからせてやる”べきか
text.en: When I'm serving at the Fuuma estate, I sometimes get scolded by that maid and it leaves me perplexed. Should I... "teach her a lesson"?

text.ja: 『フローレンシアの猟犬』。それが私の異名です。革命の空手形を妄信して多くの血を浴びた狂犬。唾棄すべき敗残者です
text.en: "The Hound of Florencia" - that's my alias. A mad dog that blindly believed in the empty promises of revolution and was bathed in the blood of many. A despicable loser.

text.ja: 隊長さん、申しわけないけれど、私がこの部隊にいるのは一時だけよ。私は永遠にラブレス家の犬。……彼らは私の心を救ってくれた
text.en: Captain, I'm sorry, but my time in this unit is only temporary. I'll always be a dog of the Lovelace family... they saved my heart.

text.ja: いずれ私もこの身の罪に相応しい地獄に落ちるだろう。でもその最後の一瞬まで、私はあの方を見守りお仕えするわ。それが私の、ただ一つの願い
text.en: Eventually, I'll fall into the depths of hell, a fate fitting for my sins. But until that final moment, I'll watch over and serve them. That's my one and only wish.
